item.title: Masuzushi: Toyama's Bamboo-Wrapped Pressed Trout Sushi — Guide
item.description: Masuzushi is Toyama’s signature local dish, a round, bamboo-wrapped pressed sushi topped with vinegar-cured trout that is pressed into a distinctive circular wooden mould lined with bamboo leaves, giving the finished sushi both its shape and a subtle bamboo fragrance. Long popular as one of Japan’s most famous ekiben (train-station boxed lunches), masuzushi is sold in specialty shops, department stores and at Toyama Station itself, with dozens of individual shops each offering slightly different recipes and levels of vinegar tartness.
